8 REPORT AGARI | LONDON BLUE Evolving Tactics: London Blue Starts Spoofing Target Domains In late-February, London Blue made a rather dramatic shift in their attack methodology. Rather than simply using a free and temporary email account with an imposter display name to send their BEC emails, a tactic the group has used consistently since 2016, they started spoofing the email address of the target company’s CEO as a way to add a bit more authenticity to their malicious attacks.
